claim_1.claim: Transcription profiling by array analysis of blood from 20 healthy adults vaccinated with MenACWY-CRM or MenACWY-PS showed differential expression of transcripts annotated as antibody segments 7 days after the initial dose, with fold-changes in IGKC and IGHG2 genes correlating with MenC-specific SBA titres and memory B cell ELISpots 28 days post-vaccination.

sources.quote: The transcriptomic profile 7 days after the initial dose of MenACWY vaccine was characterised by differential expression of transcripts annotated as antibody segments; fold-changes in IGKC and IGHG2 genes correlated with MenC-specific SBA titres and memory B cell ELISpots 28 days post-vaccination.
Blood samples were taken at study days 0 (prior to the first vaccine), 7, 28 (prior to the second vaccine), 35 and 56.
